relations.subject: Joel Tatelman
relations.evidence: To my thesis supervisor, Professor Alexis Sanderson, I pay special tribute for the many hours he spent patiently discussing the innumerable problems which bedevilled this novice text-editor.

relations.subject: Richard Gombrich
relations.evidence: I would first like to thank Professor Richard Gombrich, who, in my first year at Oxford, administered, with great good humour, the essential baptême de feu which got me off to a proper start.
